source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1930, p. 9 ("Ulster local elections: the contests in Fermanagh and Tyrone")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the block image of the Belfast News-Letter results of 6 June 1930 and checked against the Derry Journal and Ulster Herald

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Three contests: Crockanboy, Glenlark and Fallagh. The other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Unopposed returns added from the Ulster Herald's nominations list of 26 April 1930, p. 5 (6 Nov 2026). Mayne is not recorded: the nominee's name is damaged on the page image. M'Crea (Official Nat.) 138; Bradley (Nat.) 55; majority 83.
